note: Particle Health, health data API; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2020 (firm's own page), Form D 2020-2022 with Greg Yap.

PatientSafe Solutions, bedside clinical communication; acquired by Vocera in 2020. Christopher Kersey appears on the Form Ds, but he left Menlo in 2002 for Camden Partners and these are Camden-era filings — the row is a member only because DOUG CARLISLE is also a related person on them, which is the Menlo seat. First listed 2009 (wayback 2012); entry round not established.

Peregrine Technologies, data integration and analysis for public safety; the firm's own Milestones read 'Partnered, Seed (prior)' in 2018 — a seed position taken before the current fund family, recorded as Seed.

Periscope, live video streaming; Twitter acquired it in 2015 before launch and retired the app in 2021. Menlo partnered at the seed in 2014 (firm's own page). The Wikidata GR country pre-fill is a namesake collision.
PernixData, server-side storage acceleration; Nutanix acquired it in 2016. Listed 2015 with no milestone; entry round not established.
Photomath, camera-based maths tutoring; Google acquired it in 2023. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2020 (firm's own page). Croatian-founded with a San Mateo office.
PillPack, full-service pharmacy; Amazon acquired it in 2018 for ~$753M. Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2015 (firm's own page).
Pinecone, managed vector database; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2022 (firm's own page), Form D 2022-2023 to $100M with Tim Tully. Last primary $750M (2023 Series B) — below the band.
Platform9 Systems, private cloud management; on the job board and a 2015 listing with no milestone. Entry round not established.
PlayPhone, mobile social gaming; GungHo Online Entertainment acquired it in 2015. Form D 2012 $51.5M with Shawn Carolan.
PlaySpan, in-game payments; Visa acquired it in 2011 for $190M. Form D 2010 $11.0M with Shawn Carolan.
Pliant Technology, enterprise SSDs; SanDisk acquired it in 2011 for $327M. Form D 2010 $27.3M with Mark Siegel.
Pliant Therapeutics, fibrosis therapeutics; NASDAQ IPO 2020 (PLRX). Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2018 (firm's own page). The SEC float carries the below_1b band.
Pluribus Networks, network virtualization; Arista Networks acquired it in 2022. Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2012 (firm's own page); the Form D band read Series A off the same year's filing.
Polly, mortgage capital markets automation; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page).
Poshmark: Menlo led the $12M Series B in Dec 2012 (firm's own page and the company's own release). NASDAQ IPO 2021 (POSH); Naver acquired it in 2023 for $1.2B, which retires the standalone mark.

PowerReviews, ratings and reviews; merged with Bazaarvoice in 2012, divested in 2013 and now trades independently again. First listed 2006 on the window edge with no stated round; entry_stage left null.
Prime Intellect, decentralised AI training and compute; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2025 (firm's own page).
Prodigal, conversational AI for lending and collections; Menlo led the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page and its own announcement post).
Puppet, infrastructure automation; Perforce acquired it in 2022. A REST-only listing with no milestone; entry round not established.
Q1 Labs, SIEM (QRadar); IBM acquired it in 2011. Canadian company. First listed 2004, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Qualia, real-estate closing software; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2018 (firm's own page). Last primary above $1B on the 2021 Series D.
Qualified Health, governed enterprise AI for healthcare; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2026 (firm's own page).
Qualio, cloud QMS for life sciences; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2021 (firm's own page). Irish-founded with a San Francisco office.
ReadyForce, campus recruiting; wound down around 2015. Form D 2010 $14.0M with Douglas Carlisle.

RealtyShares, real-estate crowdfunding; stopped taking new investments in 2018 and its book was transferred. Menlo led the $10M Series A in 2015 (its own announcement post), Form D 2015-2017 with John Jarve.

Recursion Pharmaceuticals (RXRX, Nasdaq), AI-driven drug discovery; IPO 2021 and merged with Exscientia in 2024. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2017 (firm's own page). A public $1B+ row: the cited market cap is owed by the A/B pass.
Redfast, in-app user engagement; acquired by Pandora in 2017. A REST-only listing with no milestone; entry round not established.
Redfin (RDFN, Nasdaq), online real-estate brokerage; IPO 2017, Rocket Companies acquired it in 2025, which retires the standalone mark. Form D 2011 $14.8M with Venky Ganesan dates the Series A entry.
RelationalAI, relational knowledge graph database; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page).
Relyance AI, data governance and privacy; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page).

RF Surgical Systems, retained-surgical-item detection; Medtronic acquired it in 2015 for $235M. Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2008 (firm's own page); the band read Seed off the 2010-2013 filings.
RightHand Robotics, robotic piece-picking; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2018 (firm's own page); the band read Series A off the same year's filing.
Riva Health, smartphone blood-pressure measurement; Form D 2022 $7.25M with Greg Yap. On the job board but not on the portfolio listing.
Rivet Health, healthcare payments SaaS; Zelis acquired it in 2024. Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2020 (firm's own page), Form D 2020 $8.25M with Croom Beatty.
Rivulet Communications, network transport for medical imaging; wound down. First listed 2006 on the window edge; the band's 'Seed' rides a 2009 $1.6M filing, so the entry round is not established.
RNA Networks, memory virtualization; Dell acquired it in 2011. Listed from 2009 with no milestone and no Menlo filing; entry round not established.

Rogue Wave Software, C++ component libraries; NASDAQ IPO 1996, taken private in 2007 and merged into Perforce in 2019. A 1990s Menlo position on the 1998 software page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Rover, pet care marketplace; NASDAQ-listed by SPAC in 2021 (ROVR), Blackstone took it private in 2024 for $2.3B. Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2014 (firm's own page).

Rubric, enterprise marketing automation; Broadbase Software acquired it in 2000 (the 2000 listing reads 'Broadbase (Rubric)'). A 1990s Menlo position on the 1998 software and internet pages, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
RunSybil, AI offensive security testing; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2026 (firm's own page).
Runwise, boiler and heating management for buildings; a 2025 listing with Steve Sloane attributed and no milestone. A later-stage entry, uncited.
Sana Labs, AI learning platform; Workday acquired it in 2025 for $1.1B. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2022 (firm's own page and its own announcement post). Swedish company.
Scality, object and file storage software; a 2014 listing with no milestone. French-founded, US-headquartered per the pre-fill. Entry round not established.

Schooner Information Technology, flash-optimised databases; SanDisk acquired it in 2012. Form D 2009 $20.0M with Mark Siegel. The GB country pre-fill is a namesake collision — Schooner was a Menlo Park company.
